title: Terrible value with junky products
text: This is NOT a good value for your money and I got it half off on daily deal. I got February box which included a planner, eyeliner, sanitizing wipes, 2 different face masks, and salt pepper shakers that looked like rocks. Nobody wants a planner in February. Nobody wants dumb salt and pepper shakers. The eyeliner was smeared awful within minutes of putting on. The masks were underwhelming. The sanitizing wipes was the best deal and I can get those from Walmart's for less than $2 bucks. Save your money and please do not buy this box.
label: negative
